rules.description: Checks date freshness across Brazil Census StatVars.

params.query: SELECT StatVar, MaxDate, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_svs FROM stats
params.condition: CASE WHEN StatVar IN ('Count_Student', 'Count_Student_Nursery', 'Count_Student_PreKindergarten', 'Count_Student_AdultEducation', 'Count_Student_PrimaryEducation', 'Count_Student_BRAHighSchool', 'Count_Student_BachelorsDegree', 'Count_Student_MastersDegreeOrHigher', 'Count_Person_15OrMoreYears', 'Count_Person_15OrMoreYears_Male', 'Count_Person_15OrMoreYears_Female', 'Count_Person_15OrMoreYears_Literate', 'Count_Person_15OrMoreYears_Male_Literate', 'Count_Person_15OrMoreYears_Female_Literate', 'Count_Person_15OrMoreYears_Illiterate', 'Count_Person_15OrMoreYears_Male_Illiterate', 'Count_Person_15OrMoreYears_Female_Illiterate') OR StatVar LIKE 'Count_Person_10OrMoreYears%' OR StatVar LIKE 'Count_Person_%Years%' THEN MaxDate >= '2022' WHEN StatVar LIKE '%Illiterate_AsAFractionOf%' OR StatVar LIKE '%School%' THEN MaxDate >= '2010' WHEN StatVar = 'Count_Student_BrazilPreVestibular' OR StatVar LIKE '%Literate_AsAFractionOf%' THEN MaxDate >= '2000' ELSE MaxDate >= '1940' END AND total_svs > 0

rules.description: Checks that StatVars cover at least 27 places (or 33 for state+region+national).
